briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier model race with multimodal leaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as major labs release advanced reasoning models amid rising geopolitical stakes. Compute scaling continues aggressively while safety concerns mount over uncontrolled agentic systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with 2T parameters achieving new SOTA on GPQA. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Meta's Llama 4.5 follow closely with open weights. DeepSeek R2 challenges US dominance in efficiency benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and automotive CAN bus deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to xAI and Microsoft. Google expands TPU v7 pods in new Arizona gigafactory adding 500k H100-equivalent chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow Western labs enough for Chinese models to close the capability gap by 2027?
